name: Kawasaki Vulcan 1700 (Voyager, Nomad, Vaquero, Classic)
engine: 1700 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive
intro: Kawasaki's big belt-drive V-twin tourers. 2009-2015 Voyagers and 2011-2015 Vaqueros have an ignition wire recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2009-2015 Voyagers and 2011-2015 Vaqueros are in recall 15V550 for an ignition switch wire that can chafe on the tank.
A-002.reason: A short can stall the engine. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Ignition switch wire can chafe against the fuel tank and short, stalling the engine.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces damaged switches and adds shielding and padding, free.
